purpose: One status lane on a board: a status icon, title, count, an add action and a list of IssueCard, placed side by side with other lanes.

Default.visual: The lane on Surface/layer-1 (a tray, so its cards read raised); status icon (Size/icon-sm) and count in Content/secondary; title in Content/primary (Type/label).

a11y.role: list (labelled by the title and the count)
a11y.keyboard: No keys of its own; the add action and each IssueCard are reached by Tab.
